dataset.title: Harmonized public geospatial data for steep-terrain watershed research: Upper Tenderfoot Creek (HUC12 100301030801)

abstract.para: Terrain, stream network, soil erodibility, rainfall intensity, forest canopy, disturbance history, and road layers for one watershed, assembled from public sources (USGS 3DEP and NHDPlus HR, the Watershed Boundary Dataset, NRCS SSURGO, NOAA Atlas 14, LANDFIRE canopy cover, canopy height, and Annual Disturbance, and USFS National Forest System roads) by a reproducible R pipeline. All layers share one coordinate reference system and grid, attributes are harmonized through a documented crosswalk, and every processing decision is recorded in the project's decision log.

intellectualRights.para: This dataset is released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0). Source data are public domain U.S. government products from USGS, NRCS, NOAA, the LANDFIRE program, and the USDA Forest Service.

description.para: Revision 3. The dataset is rebuilt by rerunning the pipeline; each revision is logged in 2_protocol/changelog.csv with its date and what changed.

changeHistory.comment: Revision 1: First release: watershed, DEM, streams, soils, precipitation, LANDFIRE forest structure, and LANDFIRE disturbance summaries on the common grid.

Revision 2: dist_last_severity: Moderate labels now rank 2 (they were unranked, so older severities showed through) and code 0 marks disturbances without a severity class; added the disturbance code lookup file; data dictionary says derived from for raster values; crosswalk and EML settings updated for the LANDFIRE layers.
Revision 3: Added USFS National Forest System roads (road number, name, length, jurisdiction, status, maintenance levels, functional class, surface type, open for use to), clipped to the watershed.

description.para: Each layer is downloaded by script, saved unchanged with its source metadata, and logged with its source, version, and retrieval date. Layers are then reprojected to a common coordinate reference system, resampled to a common grid, masked to the watershed, and harmonized to consistent attribute names, units, and NoData values using a documented crosswalk. Raw downloads (where logged) and final files carry MD5 checksums, and revisions are logged in 2_protocol/changelog.csv. Automated quality checks are reported in the rendered summary report. The steps below describe each layer. Pipeline code version: git commit 0f5743b (with uncommitted changes).

watershed_boundary: USGS Watershed Boundary Dataset via nhdplusTools::get_huc() (https://www.usgs.gov/national-hydrography/watershed-boundary-dataset). Version: WBD record load date 2024-08-15; nhdplusTools 1.5.2. Retrieved: 2026-10-21 23:38:13 MDT. Raw file MD5: 7459bd2c2f5e0dde38813073116df6b7. Processing: Reprojected to output CRS; attributes renamed and converted per crosswalk. Scripts: get_watershed.R; harmonize_grid.R (harmonize_watershed); harmonize_attributes.R.

dem: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second seamless DEM (current), read via GDAL /vsicurl/ (https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/n47w111/USGS_13_n47w111.tif; https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/n48w111/USGS_13_n48w111.tif; https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/n47w112/USGS_13_n47w112.tif; https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/n48w112/USGS_13_n48w112.tif). Version: 3DEP current tiles: n47w111, n48w111, n47w112, n48w112; source dates 19520101 to 20221007 (range across all source projects in the tiles; see dem_tiles_100301030801.csv); vertical datum North American Vertical Datum of 1988; cropped to watershed + 1000 m buffer. Retrieved: 2026-11-11 20:43:08 MST. Raw file MD5: ff9a9b6500ed4f668e50ff54f1f84f01. Processing: Reprojected and resampled (bilinear) to common grid; masked to watershed; no pit or flat filling; elevations keep the source vertical datum (see version); NoData = -9999. Scripts: get_dem.R; harmonize_grid.R (harmonize_dem).

streams: USGS NHDPlus HR network flowlines via nhdplusTools::get_nhdphr(), queried in tiles (https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/NHDPlus_HR/MapServer). Version: 135 flowlines from 4 tiles; nhdplusTools 1.5.2. Retrieved: 2026-10-12 17:13:48 MDT. Raw file MD5: not recorded (downloaded before checksums were logged). Processing: Reprojected to output CRS; clipped to watershed; attributes renamed and converted per crosswalk. Scripts: get_streams.R; harmonize_grid.R (harmonize_streams); harmonize_attributes.R.

soils: NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access (soilDB::SDA_spatialQuery, SDA_query) (https://sdmdataaccess.nrcs.usda.gov). Version: Survey MT632, version date 9/5/2026 2:51:43 PM; soilDB 2.9.2. Retrieved: 2026-11-11 20:43:13 MST. Raw file MD5: 35cc861fd96c9b8d0cbf7821da59afda; 6ab3b2dc49de4b67bd6c2329f0f65875. Processing: Component K from first horizon with a value; map unit K as component-percent weighted mean of components with K (kwfact and kffact separately); percent of map unit without K recorded; polygons rasterized to common grid (cell centers); masked to watershed; NoData = -9999. Scripts: get_soils.R; harmonize_soils.R.

precip: NOAA Atlas 14 precipitation frequency grids, partial duration series (PFDS) (https://hdsc.nws.noaa.gov/pub/hdsc/data/inw/inw2yr30ma.zip; https://hdsc.nws.noaa.gov/pub/hdsc/data/inw/inw2yr60ma.zip; https://hdsc.nws.noaa.gov/pub/hdsc/data/inw/inw2yr06ha.zip). Version: NOAA Atlas 14 Volume 12 Version 2 (folder inw); 2-year ARI; durations 30m, 60m, 06h. Retrieved: 2026-11-11 21:44:33 MST. Raw file MD5: 69e138657027f587216d5868fb23c01c; ebf959c680e9a8cda74225a588d32ad6; a8670467790dc0aa6504be4b5c225754; d9ab2dfc55982189258fee595f74b2a2. Processing: Grids read from original zips; NAD83 geographic assigned where the grid has no CRS; cropped to watershed + 2 km; depth (0.001 in) converted to intensity (mm/hr) using crosswalk factors; resampled (bilinear) from ~800 m to common grid; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999. Scripts: get_precip.R; harmonize_precip.R.

forest: LANDFIRE Product Service v2 via rlandfire::landfireAPIv2() (https://lfps.usgs.gov). Version: LF2024_CC, LF2024_CH; rlandfire 2.0.2. Retrieved: 2026-10-14 21:17:09 MDT. Raw file MD5: not recorded (downloaded before checksums were logged). Processing: LANDFIRE products requested in output CRS; canopy height converted from decimeters to meters; resampled from 30 m to common grid with nearest neighbor (classed values); masked to watershed; NoData = -9999. Scripts: get_forest.R; harmonize_forest.R.

disturbance: LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance (final) via rlandfire::landfireAPIv2(); attribute tables from landfire.gov (https://lfps.usgs.gov; https://landfire.gov/sites/default/files/CSV/AllYears/DistCSV_AllYears.zip?release=R5). Version: 1999-2025; products LF2001_Dist99, LF2001_Dist00, LF2001_Dist01, LF2001_Dist02, LF2001_Dist03, LF2001_Dist04, LF2001_Dist05, LF2001_Dist06, LF2001_Dist07, LF2008_Dist08, LF2010_Dist09, LF2010_Dist10, LF2012_Dist11, LF2012_Dist12, LF2014_Dist13, LF2014_Dist14, LF2016_Dist15, LF2016_Dist16, LF2020_Dist17, LF2020_Dist18, LF2020_Dist19, LF2020_Dist20, LF2022_Dist21, LF2022_Dist22, LF2023_Dist23, LF2024_Dist24, LF2025_Dist25; attribute tables dated 20250127, 20250727, 20250129, 20241022, 20241023, 20230426, 20241212, 20241219, 20260213; rlandfire 2.0.2. Retrieved: 2026-10-14 22:05:11 MDT. Raw file MD5: not recorded (downloaded before checksums were logged). Processing: Annual codes translated with each year's own LANDFIRE attribute table; LANDFIRE DIST_TYPE values grouped into harvest, fire, insect, and other per 2_protocol/dist_type_groups.csv; LANDFIRE SEVERITY labels ranked 1 (low or unburned), 2 (medium or moderate), 3 (high) by their first word, and 0 when the label is not a severity class (e.g. No Severity). Summarized per cell at 30 m: each group keeps its own most recent year, so a cell with insect mortality that later burned has both an insect year and a fire year; dist_last_severity is the severity of the most recent disturbance of any group; dist_count is the number of years with any disturbance. Every source label with its assigned group and rank is listed in the watershed's 4_product/data/disturbance_codes_[HUC12].csv. Resampled to common grid with nearest neighbor; masked to watershed; NoData = -9999. Scripts: get_disturbance.R; harmonize_disturbance.R.

roads: USFS National Forest System Roads (EDW_RoadBasic_01 map service, layer 0) (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RoadBasic_01/MapServer/0). Version: EDW road data, updated daily from national forest databases; 22 segments touching the watershed. Retrieved: 2026-11-11 20:42:58 MST. Raw file MD5: 1317b574ede4cdcb34d7638276d0790e. Processing: National Forest System roads only (no county, state, or private roads); reprojected to output CRS; clipped to watershed; attributes renamed and converted per crosswalk (GIS miles to km). road_length_km describes the whole road segment, not the clipped piece. Scripts: get_roads.R; harmonize_grid.R (harmonize_roads); harmonize_attributes.R.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Severity class of the most recent disturbance: 0 no severity class, 1 low, 2 medium or moderate, 3 high (LANDFIRE Annual Disturbance SEVERITY)

codeDefinition.definition: No severity class: disturbed, but the LANDFIRE SEVERITY label is not a severity class (e.g. No Severity, Increased Green, blank)
Low: LANDFIRE SEVERITY label beginning with Low or Unburned (e.g. Low, Low-Medium, Unburned/Low)
Medium: LANDFIRE SEVERITY label beginning with Medium or Moderate (e.g. Medium, Medium-High, Moderate, Moderate-Low, Moderate-High)
High: LANDFIRE SEVERITY label beginning with High
